dct_description_sm: This project consisted of a workshop aimed at developing an action plan on climate change adaptation in Haines Junction and the larger Yukon Territory. The workshop aimed to create and build partnerships while collecting information from both scientific and traditional views on the subject of climate change and potential impacts in the Champagne and Aishihik First Nations Traditional Territory to assess and identify risks and opportunities. It also aimed to discuss the results of the Climate Change in our Backyard 1 conference and receive feedback for the planning of a Climate Change in our Backyard 3: Building the Action Plan project. awareness raising and youth invovlement were also aims of this project.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Climate Change in Our Backyard 2: Building Towards an Action Plan
